_comment: The seam between the staged product builder and the Rust extractor. The four tests that existed before the cutover never reach this code — every production caller is inside a buildStaged* function — so these trials are killed only by the two that drive the seam itself.
verify: cd host && npx vitest run test/staged-product-inputs.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1

trials.name: a failed extraction is reported as success
the reason an archive was refused is the first line of cargo's noise
a spawn that never ran is treated as an extraction that worked
the single-root strip is never requested
the expected root is never passed to the extractor
